summary.text: Blood Petals is an immortal killer move Wan Zi Hong uses without visible motion. Struck targets spout blood that scatters like floating petals.

claims.text: Wan Zi Hong takes the main attacker role against Thousand Transformations Ancestor and Myriad Transformations Ancestor, and tells Xing Ye Wang and Prince Feng Xian to support her with all their strength. She goes on the offensive and her aura rises at once. She does not look like she has made any movements, but blood starts spouting out of Thousand Transformations and Myriad Transformations, spewing from their bodies like floating petals and scattering randomly. Myriad Transformations Ancestor is Myriad Statue Palace in human form at that moment and still receives the injury.

She next activates Helpless Withering, a different killer move: petals around her whirl down and ruin Thousand Transformations Ancestor’s long range attacks. She then uses yellow flowers thinning life as a separate trump card in the same clash.
